name: Kenta Kitagawa
main_effect:
[Your Turn] When you would play [MarineAngemon] from your hand, reduce its play cost by 1.
[Your Turn] When you play a blue Digimon, you may suspend this Tamer to trash the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if the Digimon that played is [MarineAngemon], trash the bottom digivolution card of all of your opponent's Digimon.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
